abilities.name: Obliterating Charge
abilities.effect: Add X to charge rolls for friendly Blades of Khorne units, where X is the number of friendly Blades of Khorne Cavalry or Monster units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.

abilities.name: Butchers of Nations
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for a friendly Blades of Khorne Daemon unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Bloodbound unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Eager Killers
abilities.timing: End of Your Turn
abilities.effect: Each friendly Blades of Khorne Daemon unit that has used a Fight ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Tireless Conquerors
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Bloodbound units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: Bloody Competitors
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero Bloodbound unit and a friendly non-Hero Blades of Khorne Daemon unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets' combat attacks.

abilities.name: Tide of Savagery
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Bloodbound Hero and up to 2 other friendly Bloodbound units that are wholly within 12" of that Hero to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the targets' Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Blood-drenched
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Skulls for the Skull Throne' ability
abilities.effect: After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a Blood Tithe ability this turn, pick a friendly Blades of Khorne unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle: *Wild-eyed Brutality:* Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for friendly Blades of Khorne units. *Blood Haze:* Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly Bloodbound units have Crit (Mortal). *Weapons of Murder:* Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly Blades of Khorne non-Monster Daemon units, including Blood-hungry Companion weapons. *Bloodlords Supreme:* Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly Blades of Khorne Monster units.

abilities.name: Blood for the Blood God
abilities.effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock Blood Tithe abilities. You can only use Blood Tithe abilities that are unlocked. Once a Blood Tithe ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.

abilities.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Pick a Blood Tithe ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability. That Blood Tithe ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Murderlust
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Charge ability.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that Charge ability after that ability is resolved.

abilities.name: Divine Scorn
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy Wizards or Priests within 6" of any friendly Blades of Khorne units to be the target(s).
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.

abilities.name: Punish the Pacifist
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy Manifestation that is not in combat is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.

abilities.name: Murder the Mystic
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army),Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 4 enemy Manifestations to be the target(s).
abilities.effect: Make a banishment roll of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that Manifestation's warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: Glorious Combat or Naught
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly Blades of Khorne units.

abilities.name: Revel in Battle
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly Blades of Khorne unit have no effect.

abilities.name: Slaughter Triumphant
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly Blades of Khorne units that charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne
abilities.timing: Passive
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Blades of Khorne units.

powers.name: Blood Boil
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

powers.name: Uncontrollable Rage
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability (see 'Battle Traits') apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of 'Wild-eyed Brutality' on the target.

powers.name: Final Act of Violence
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Blades of Khorne unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
powers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll as 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Sigil of Doom
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Blades of Khorne unit wholly within 8" of this Manifestation to be the target. Then, pick a passive Blood Tithe ability that you have not unlocked this battle.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the blood tithe points cost of the chosen ability, , until the start of your next turn, the effects of that ability apply to the target as if it had been unlocked.

summon.name: Summon Bleeding Icon
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Bleeding Icon on the battlefield, pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Priest to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Bleeding Icon wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.

abilities.name: Hexgorgers
abilities.effect: For each part of this Manifestation that is within 8" of a Wizard (friendly or enemy), subtract 1 from casting rolls for that Wizard.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 8" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with a Stream of Molten Blood.

summon.name: Summon Hexgorger Skulls
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Hexgorger Skulls invocation on the battlefield, pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Priest to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Hexgorger Skulls invocation wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Hexgorger Skulls invocation has 2 parts that must be set up within 8" of each other.

abilities.name: Hatred's Edge
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit with a starting size greater than 1 that is in combat with this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. On an 8+, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

summon.name: Summon Wrath-axe
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Wrath-axe on the battlefield, pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Priest to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Wrath-axe wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

summon.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.timing: Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this Manifestation's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Wizard Hero within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

summon.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 maelstrom points. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

summon.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.timing: Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: For each part of this Manifestation, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

summon.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Wizard within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

summon.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

summon.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

weapons.name: Burning Breath
weapons.ability: Shoot in Combat, Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this Manifestation (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Collar of Contempt
abilities.effect: This unit can use Unbind abilities as if it had Wizard (1). Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

abilities.name: Butcher's Blade
abilities.timing: End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Ar'gath, the King of Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy Heroes while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Magical Scorn
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for Wizards while they are within 12" of this unit. Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy Priests while they are within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Skull Collector
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy Hero by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy Hero has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilities.name: Frenzied Taskmaster
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Infantry or Cavalry unit within this unit's combat range that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit's combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Words of Hate
abilities.effect: While this terrain feature has an Invoker: • Add 1 to chanting rolls for the Invoker. • The Invoker cannot use Move abilities. • Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Invoker, measure to this terrain feature instead. • All attacks that would target the Invoker target this terrain feature instead. • If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Invoker. Then, set up the Invoker on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer an Invoker. If it is not possible to set up the Invoker, it is slain.

abilities.name: Ascend the Altar
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have an Invoker, pick a friendly Blades of Khorne Infantry Priest within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now an Invoker (see 'Words of Hate').

abilities.name: Hatred of Sorcery
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature has an Invoker, pick up to D3 enemy Endless Spells within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target(s) and make a banishment roll of 2D6 for each target.
abilities.effect: Resolve the effect of the 'Banish Manifestation' ability for each target. If any Endless Spells are banished by this ability, you gain 1 blood tithe point.

abilities.name: Descend the Altar
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has an Invoker that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Invoker on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer an Invoker.

abilities.name: The Blood Must Flow
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Bloodletters unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit and that friendly Bloodletters unit.

abilities.name: Icon of the Blood God
abilities.effect: If a friendly Bloodbound unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Rage of Khorne
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of friendly Bloodbound units' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Whipped to Fury
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero Bloodbound unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use Charge abilities even if it used a Run ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Great Axe of Khorne is 3.

abilities.name: Shattering Charge
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is Infantry, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Outrageous Carnage
abilities.effect: Each time an attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 8" of it after the Fight ability has been resolved (and continue the attack sequence).

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Axe of Khorne is 4.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Lash
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: If the target is in combat with this unit when the target is picked to use a Fight ability: • It must pick this unit to be the target of the pile-in move (Core Rules, 15.3). • Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made as part of that Fight ability against this unit.

abilities.name: Beckon the Hunt
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Unique Blades of Khorne Daemon unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for the target, roll 1 additional dice, to a maximum of 3, and discard 1 dice of your choice.

abilities.name: Trophies of Glorious Deaths
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 8" of this unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. This reaction cannot be used more than once per command.

abilities.name: Killer of Kings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit and Manifestation in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model from that unit is slain, or, if the target is a Manifestation, it is automatically destroyed.

units.name: Herald of Khorne on Blood Throne

abilities.name: Blood Marked
abilities.effect: This unit has Ward (4+) against damage inflicted by Spell abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.

abilities.name: Offering of Blood
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add 1 to this unit's power level, to a maximum of 2.

abilities.name: Prey of the Blood God
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Pick an enemy Hero to be this unit's quarry. You can pick a Hero in reserve.

abilities.name: Stalk the Prey
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit's quarry is on the battlefield, pick this unit and up to 1 friendly Flesh hounds unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 6" from this unit's quarry and more than 9" from all other enemy units. If picked to be a target, the unit of Flesh Hounds must also be set up wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: First of the Pack
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Flesh Hounds unit, add 2 to charge rolls for this unit. In addition, while any friendly Flesh Hounds units are wholly within 12" of this unit, they can ignore the effect of the 'Beast' ability.

abilities.name: Retinue of Blood
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Bloodbound Hero within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: The targets' melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Master of the Goretide
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Spend 3 blood tithe points and pick a friendly Bloodbound unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by combat attacks made by this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, one model in that unit is slain.

abilities.name: Loathe the Arcane
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a Spell ability
abilities.effect: This unit can use this ability if it is not in combat. This unit can move 3" but must end that move closer to the unit that used the Spell ability. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: Ascended Warlord
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Axe of Khorne for each other friendly Blades of Khorne unit that is within this unit's combat range and in combat.

abilities.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by combat attacks made by this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, one model in that unit is slain.

abilities.name: Lord of the Brass Stampede
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for Blades of Khorne Cavalry units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Slaughterous Charge
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Lord of the Bloodbound
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly Bloodbound Infantry units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: 'Bring Me Their Skull!'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly Bloodbound Infantry Hero wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

units.name: Mighty Lord of Khorne (Scourge of Ghyran)

abilities.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick an enemy Hero that was allocated any damage points by this unit's Axe of Khorne this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Howl of Blood-Curdling Savagery
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendly Bloodbound unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the target has charged.

abilities.name: Desecrating Blood Runes
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Bloodbound units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.

abilities.name: Bestial Leap
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this phase, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6" as if it had Fly but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Brass Collar of Khorne
abilities.effect: This unit can use Unbind abilities as if it had Wizard (1).

abilities.name: Skarbrand's Rage
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, or if it did not use a Fight ability last turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability apply to this unit.

abilities.name: Roar of Total Rage
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of damage points this unit has. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Inescapable Wrath
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: The Slaughterborn
abilities.timing: Any Movement Phase
abilities.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Murderous Paragon
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Wrathmongers units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Bone-crushing Strikes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target's control characteristic, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Tempered by Fury
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly Bloodbound Hero within 8" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Slaughterous Charge
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Herald of Trampling Death
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Bloodcrushers unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by this unit and the target have Charge (+1 Damage).

abilities.name: Heroes' Bane
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, this unit has Strike-first but all of its combat attacks must target that enemy Hero.

abilities.name: The Eternal Duel
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If an enemy Hero had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that Hero was destroyed this turn, Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points this unit has.

abilities.name: Drawn by Blood
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Hero unit that used a Fight ability this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.

abilities.name: Scorn of Sorcery
abilities.effect: This unit can use Unbind abilities as if it had Wizard (1).

abilities.name: Blood Sacrifice
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • This unit gains 1 ritual point.

abilities.name: Borne on Wings of Blood
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve soaring above the battlefield. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: The Red Angel of Slaughter
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is soaring above the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit and roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Gaze of Khorne
abilities.effect: If a friendly Bloodbound unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6. However, friendly Bloodbound units cannot use Retreat abilities while they are within 12" of this unit.

weapons.name: Mighty Axe of Khorne and Bloodflail

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Mighty Axe of Khorne and Bloodflail is 4.

abilities.name: Vengeance of Khorne
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Hero in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 8 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Commander of Tyrants
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another visible friendly non-Unique Blades of Khorne Daemon unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Wrathful Dominance
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks that target an enemy Hero.

abilities.name: No Respite
abilities.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, it has Ward (5+)

abilities.name: Only the Worthy
abilities.effect: The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of models in this unit that are slain. 1+ Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit. 4+ Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks. 8+ Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks. 16+ Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons and this unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Crushing Onslaught
abilities.effect: If the unmodified charge roll for this unit is 8+: • For the rest of the phase, this unit can pass through models in enemy units. • Enemy Cavalry units passed through by this unit in this phase cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Brass Stampede
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through models in the target unit and must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Ceaseless Violence
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Drawn to Slaughter
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You or your opponent declared the 'Eruption of Fury' ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.effect: Return 1 slain model to this unit. If your opponent declared that 'Eruption of Fury' ability and the unit using the ability is in combat with this unit, return 3 slain models to this unit instead.

abilities.name: Blood for the Blood God!
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: The Scent of Blood
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Pack Hunters
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly Flesh Hounds unit or a friendly Karanak, this unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Hunters of Mystics
abilities.effect: If the casting roll for an enemy Wizard within 12" of this unit contains 2 or more results of 1 or 2, the spell is miscast. If the chanting roll for an enemy Priest within 12" of this unit is an unmodified 2, the prayer fails and its effect is not resolved. In addition, your opponent cannot give that Priest any ritual points for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Blood for the Blood God!
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Grisly Trophies
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: If this unit is in a Blades of Khorne army and any enemy models were slain this turn by this unit's attacks, you gain 1 blood tithe point.

abilities.name: Grisly Trophies
abilities.effect: While this unit's Dromm, Wounder of Worlds, is on the battlefield, it has Priest (1) and can use Unbind abilities as if it had Wizard (1)

abilities.name: Khornate Hound
abilities.effect: This unit's Kannat is a token. Each time you declare a Fight ability for this unit while its Kannat is on the battlefield, as a reaction, you can remove its Kannat from the battlefield and then add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's Bloodied Weapons for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Gather the Skulls
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain and you earn 1 blood tithe point.

abilities.name: Horrific Predators
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Feast Upon Their Bones
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy non-Monster units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: No Respite
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll 2 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Slaughterous Charge
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Gruesome Bombardment
abilities.effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by a Shoot ability used by this unit, subtract 3 from that enemy unit's control score for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Grind Their Bones, Seize Their Skulls
abilities.effect: If any enemy models are slain by a Fight ability used by this unit, after that Fight ability has been resolved, this unit can immediately use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase.

abilities.name: Trial of Skulls
abilities.effect: Add 8 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.

abilities.name: Bloodfury
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 3" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Both player's roll off. If you win the roll-off, pick a melee weapon that the target is armed with. Your opponent must pick a visible unit in their army within 3" of the target (they can pick the target's own unit, and even if it is a single-model unit). Your opponent must resolve combat attacks for the target using the melee weapon you picked against the unit they picked.

abilities.name: Crimson Haze
abilities.effect: While this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Bloodbound units, excluding Wrathmongers units, while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
